message:
Use polling for status updates

WebSockets require sticky sessions, which prevents requests from moving
between application servers.
diff:
diff --git a/status.py b/status.py
--- a/status.py
+++ b/status.py
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
-update_via_websocket(job)
+while job.pending:
+    poll(job)

name: allowed issue trailer
message:
Reject reused password tokens

Tokens are single-use so intercepted links cannot reset an account after
the owner has already changed the password.

Fixes #123
diff:
diff --git a/token.py b/token.py
--- a/token.py
+++ b/token.py
@@ -7 +7,2 @@
 reset(token)
+mark_used(token)

sentences.text: Tokens are single-use so intercepted links cannot reset an account after the owner has already changed the password.
